decisions: Sheet: read AND write the QA test plan through chrome.identity and the Sheets API; a write happens only on Apply after a shown diff, and the paste table is the fallback (Will, 2026-10-21).
A/B: complement. QA Pass never captures variants for a copy, markup, visual or accessibility diff; that is the A/B tab (Will, 2026-10-21).
Jira comments: {id, created, text}, no author (Will, 2026-10-21).
Code decides every status; Opus only explains.

synced.from: the downloaded .skill QA Pass was built from (0.7.22); seeded 2026-10-26

(frontmatter).note: The skill's name and trigger description. A changed description can still announce new scope (an environment, a platform), so read it.

(title).note: The single-pass framing is ported: the report covers this run only, and the sheet and Jira comments are context for the explain (qpExplainInput). The pairs-with and writing-standard lines are for Claude.

0. Confirm scope first.where: #qp-body settings (qp-widths, qp-quick-sweep, qp-sheet-tab, qp-sheet-col, qp-write-notes, qp-retest-inprogress) and qpUiReadSettings (popup.js); qpSkipRow, qpCellWritable, qpDefaultStatusCol (qa-pass.js)
0. Confirm scope first.note: Ported: one tab and one status column per run (Desktop Chrome by default); Screenshots, Results and Traffic rows skipped; Excluded left alone, In Progress only with re-test on, a Passed changed only when this run contradicts it; Backlog and empty cells are the ones written. Not ported: the other environment columns (BrowserStack is out), reading sibling tabs, and asking the tester (the settings card replaces it).

1. Build the baseline.where: The Jira extractor in popup.js (comments as {id, created, text}); qpwSheetRead, qpSheetModel, qpSheetVocab; check A: qpwPhaseLinks, qpSnippetProbeFn, qpProbeSummary; check B: qpwPhaseProd, qpPageFactsFn, qpCompareFacts
1. Build the baseline.note: The handoff doc is the free-text Workarounds field (qp-workarounds), not a doc read. The sheet is read through the Sheets API, not an .xlsx export.

2. Platform checks from the snippet.where: Check C: qpSnippetProbeFn, qpMatchGoals, qpSoftcodedCheck, qpUnlistedActive, qpWeights, qpAllocation
2. Platform checks from the snippet.note: Not ported, each listed in qpFixedNotTested: spec audiences (X.spec-audiences), the shared spec page ID (X.spec-page-id), softcoded IDs by id (X.softcoded-ids; matched by ticket key instead), the Optimizely-UI-only rows (X.optimizely-ui). The output-filter workaround is for Claude in Chrome; Selenite's counterpart is qpScrubUrls.

3. Code-level check (local Chrome).where: Bot check: qpPageFactsFn. State: qpwClearState (qp-clear-all). Check D, audience negatives: qpwPhaseAudiences, qpAudienceTests. Concurrency combos: qpwPhaseCombos, qpComboUrl. Check E, sweep: QP_WIDTHS, QP_PROFILES, qpwPhaseSweep, qpClipScanFn, qpEvaluateSweep, qpwCaptureTile. Check F, metrics on load: qpwInstallTrackShim, qpReadTrackFn
3. Code-level check (local Chrome).note: The sweep runs over CDP inside the extension, not Playwright. Not ported, each an X.* in qpFixedNotTested: copy, markup and links (X.copy: the A/B tab), CTA click-through, modals, metrics on their trigger, click propagation and activation on a trigger (X.click-through), custom attributes against the spec (X.custom-attributes), redirect tests (X.redirect), concurrency with promo and UTM parameters (X.concurrency-params), experiment CSS and data attributes (X.css).

4. Time-based content.note: X.time in qpFixedNotTested: the extension has no Date or time-zone override.

5. BrowserStack device matrix.note: Will's decision: BrowserStack is out of QA Pass. X.devices in qpFixedNotTested; iPhone and Android are emulated widths in desktop Chrome. The stream-typing tips have no counterpart.

6. Explain results.note: Opus cites comments, rules out environment noise and splits bugs from PGM questions; it never sets a status. 'Also on PROD' stays a bug.

7. Update the test plan.where: qpBuildProposal, qpProposalEntry, qpCellWritable, qpNoteLine ('Auto QA (M/D): ...'), qpAppendNote, qpVerifyApply (qa-pass.js); qpwSheetApply (background.js); qpUiApply (popup.js); qpPasteRows as the fallback
7. Update the test plan.note: Ported: statuses from the Values tab vocabulary, Blocked-by-row notes, appended notes, re-read before write and verify after. The Sheets UI mechanics are n/a: writes go through the Sheets API. Not ported: parent/child mirroring (X.sheet-parents).

8. Report in chat.where: rptQaPassSection (popup.js), cases in tests/qa-report.test.js; qpSeverity (360-430 px high, 320 px and below low); tiles: qpwCaptureTile, qpTileMarkFn
8. Report in chat.note: Order: Bugs, Passed, Needs PGM, Not tested, sheet rows.

9. Bugs and questions for PGM.where: The bug and PGM-question lists of the explain schema (qpExplainSystem, qpValidateExplain)
9. Bugs and questions for PGM.note: One item each, rows cited by check id. A new question kind is a prompt change; a new bug kind usually needs a new check.

decisions: Mailtrap is read from the tester's own signed-in tab, with no API token. Signed-out and personal-account states are reported, never worked around; Selenite never signs in (Will, 2026-10-23).
The copy doc is read through the Google Docs API with documents.readonly (Will, 2026-10-23).
Sheet: the QA Pass sign-in and Apply after a shown diff; the paste table is the fallback (Will, 2026-10-23).
Code decides every status. Opus writes the explain and advisory copy notes only; visuals, dark mode and graphics stay In Progress; no model review of renders (Will, 2026-10-23).
Pardot: one resolve per linkId, with the guard list; never unsubscribe or view-in-browser (Will, 2026-10-23).
A generic email check plus a selectable organisation profile; a profile is data, not code, and holds public facts only (Will, 2026-10-23).

Real client data (proofs, copy, ticket text, plan notes, ids, URLs) never enters this public repo; committed fixtures are synthetic. Email Check only reads; its one write is to the test plan (Will, 2026-10-23).

synced.from: the downloaded .skill Email Check was built from (0.7.23); seeded 2026-10-26

(frontmatter).note: The skill's name and trigger description. A changed description can still announce new scope (a new ticket type, a new tool), so read it.

(title).where: The four failure classes are rules: ecRuleRawTokens, ecRuleUtms, ecRuleLinks (destination path and title), ecImageOnlyCtaFindings (the alt of an image-only CTA)
(title).note: The pairs-with line is for Claude.

Collect these first.where: ecParseEmailLinks, ecCtxForWorker, ecSuggestRules (the 'only difference' and UTM rules from comments), ecwReadDoc and ecParseDoc (the bold option is primary), ecSheetModel (Desktop, column E, by default), EC_PROOF_PREFIX_RE
Collect these first.note: The copy doc's comments are not read (X.doc-comments).

Access: Mailtrap needs the right account.note: Signed-out, personal-account and browser-check states each get their own message; nothing is signed into or clicked.

Set the test plan up right.note: X.plan-setup: finding or copying the plan, filling A1 and labelling the groups are done by hand before the run. Email Check only reads the plan's groups as they are.

Segments vs. variations.where: ecParseGroupLabel (the label in A or B), ecSheetModel, ecRowMap, ecSameSegment; per-segment destination paths are a run setting (ec-seg-paths), not profile data
Segments vs. variations.note: Email on Acid renders are read per version (ecwReadEoa).

The variation-labelling trap.note: A group whose label doesn't fit the ticket's proofs is left unmapped with a 'relabel or split the plan by hand' reason; Email Check never restructures the sheet.

Group geometry.note: Test rows are found by their description text (EC_ROWS textRe), not by fixed offsets, so a new or moved row is an EC_ROWS change.

Getting the email out of Mailtrap.note: Same facts by another route: the Mailtrap web app's own same-origin API (body.htmlsource, body.txt, body.raw, mail_headers, spam_report) from the signed-in tab, not the iframe views. The phone, tablet and desktop views are not read (X.viewports). The sessionStorage stash is n/a.

The output filter.note: Claude in Chrome's output filter. Selenite's counterpart is its privacy scrub (ecScrubText, ecScrubDeep).

Headers (from `/raw`).where: ecHeaderBlock, ecHeaderValues, ecDkimDomains, ecDecodeRfc2047, ecSubjectParts with EC_PROOF_PREFIX_RE
Headers (from `/raw`).note: mail_headers keeps one value per header, so DKIM is read from body.raw.

Tech Info (from `/smtp_info`).where: ecRuleFromAddress, ecRuleReplyTo, ecRcptTag (the segment tag in the recipient)
Tech Info (from `/smtp_info`).note: Read from the message headers, not the Tech Info page. MAIL FROM is never compared, as the skill says.

Rendered body, links, images, preheader.where: ecVisibleText, ecStyleHides, ecStripInvisible, ecTextPart, ecImageFacts, ecAnchorFacts

Tracked links: resolve them, don't read.where: ecPardotParse, ecLinkPlan (one GET per linkId), ecLinkGuard and ecwNeverFetch (unsubscribe, view-in-browser, preference and webmail links never opened), ecParseInterstitial, ecwPardotGet, ecwDestGet; the UTM shape: EC_UTM_SHAPE, ecUtmShapeProblems
Tracked links: resolve them, don't read.note: Resolved by a fetch with cookies omitted, not WebFetch.

Email on Acid.note: Renders go into the report and the visual and dark-mode rows stay In Progress (no model review). The URL Validation tab is not read (X.eoa-url-validation), nor are the per-client screenshot pages.

Browser tooling quirks.note: Claude in Chrome quirks; nothing in Selenite corresponds.

The checks, and what actually breaks.where: The 22 row rules, ecRuleSubject to ecRuleDkim (email-check.js, 'The 22 row rules'); ecVariationDiff, ecImageOnlyCtaFindings, ecCompareBody, ecMatchOption
The checks, and what actually breaks.note: Visuals and dark mode stay In Progress or Blocked; text inside images is not read (X.graphics-text). A change to a check's rule is a change to its ecRule* function and its tests.

Statuses.note: Code decides every status; the model never does.

Writing results back.where: ecBuildProposal, ecWritesFromProposal (email-check.js); ecwSheetApply (background.js); ecUiApply (popup.js); ecPasteRows as the fallback
Writing results back.note: Apply after a shown diff; only the Desktop, Mobile, Web-Based and Notes cells can be written, and the rows are re-read before writing.

Read the row map from the CSV export, no.note: The Sheets API's values keep blank rows, which is what the CSV route is for; the header is read by its labels.

Mechanics that bite.note: Sheets UI typing mechanics; Email Check writes through the Sheets API.

Wrapping up.note: Grouped by outcome. Jira transitions and comments are never made (X.jira): Selenite never writes to Jira.

Reference.note: Links for Claude. A change to the process page it names can still matter, so read it.
